name: Consumer Installment Credit Policy (synthetic)
decision: An application that satisfies every clause below shall be approved; any other application shall be declined.

clauses.title: Credit score
clauses.text: The applicant must have a FICO score of at least 660.

clauses.title: Debt-to-income
clauses.text: The applicant's total debt-to-income ratio must not exceed 45%.

clauses.title: Loan-to-value
clauses.text: The loan-to-value ratio must not exceed 95%.
